topNews.text: Raising Rice and Fish Together Cuts Disease From Snails While Boosting Crop Yields by 25%
topNews.excerpt: The chronic disease schistosomiasis wreaks havoc on more than 220 million people around the world, with the vast majority of cases being in sub-Saharan Africa. topNews.text: 370,000 Acres of Rainforest and Granite Peaks Now Protected in French Guiana
topNews.excerpt: As part of new wildlands protection law, the French Government has announced the creation of a new nature reserve in French Guiana spanning 370,000 acres.
